marking_points.text: emission of electrons (from a metal surface)
when electromagnetic radiation is incident (on surface / electrons)
current falls to zero when applied voltage equals energy per unit charge of emitted electrons
energy of photon depends on frequency
maximum energy of electron depends on energy of photon

Any three points from: threshold frequency = 1.5 × 10^15 Hz; threshold wavelength = 2.0 × 10^-7 m; work function = 6.2 eV (or 9.9 × 10^-19 J); Planck constant = 6.6 × 10^-34 J s (not 6.63 × 10^-34 J s); number per unit time (of photons / electrons) = 1.7 × 10^16 s^-1 (in stage 1); power of incident radiation = 0.028 W (in stage 1)
